name: Mireth Mate-Coconut Surge
manufacturer: Mireth Drink Labs (street brand, Tier 2 origin)
description: A caffeinated soda built on a real mate extract base lightened with synth-coconut, positioned between an energy drink and a soft drink. Mireth runs a semi-legal distribution network that keeps it off corponation retail shelves and exclusively in independent stores.
flavor_profile: Grassy, slightly bitter real mate backbone, then a bright synthetic coconut sweetness that softens the edge — energizing without being harsh, with a clean green finish
cultural_context: Mireth is the daytime drink of freelancers, gig-workers, and the chronically over-scheduled in Tier 2. It has a reputation for delivering cleaner energy than synthetic stimulant drinks because the mate is genuinely real. The independent-only distribution is a selling point — buying Mireth feels like opting out of something.
story_hooks: Mireth's real mate supply comes from a single source — a small agricultural collective three hundred kilometers south of GLMZ — and rumors that the collective has been approached by a corponation buyer are making Mireth's distribution network very nervous

A Tier 2 courier union has informally adopted Mireth as their drink, and the brand has begun quietly funding union legal defense without making it public — a relationship that could blow up spectacularly if exposed

Someone has been cutting counterfeit Mireth with a synthetic stimulant compound and selling it through the same independent store network — the real Mireth Lab doesn't know who, and the corponations are watching to see if the scandal destroys the brand without their involvement
related_entities: Tessera Corponation ChronoMark VR-3 Passive Isotopic Citizen Tagging System
